name: dashboard-shell
description: One responsive dashboard chrome: desktop rail + topbar; mobile drops the sidebar entirely for a bottom dock + thumbnail-tile menu drawer. All three faces read a single `nav` prop.
notes: Needs shadcn `sidebar` + `drawer` installed (sidebar brings sheet + tooltip; drawer brings vaul). No Convex, no env, no localStorage. Pair with full-width-toggle in the topbar `actions` slot, workspace-shell in `sidebarHeader`.
